rv.q: Audiences looking for something less bombastic will adore this warm hug of a show.
What a wonderful, sincere telling of this classic story with the exceptionally talented cast I have come to expect from this theater.

cn.t: Critics agree this musical adaptation of Alcott's classic earns its place on stage, with a soaring score and exceptional cast bringing the March sisters' timeless story to life with sincerity and heart.
